pr_title: executor: fix null type print the wrong column type in infoschema
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: Weizhen Wang <wangweizhen@pingcap.com>

<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #38108

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

In this SQL
```
 CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`1.1.1.1` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `v_test` (
   `type`) AS
SELECT
 NULL AS `type`,
FROM
 `test` AS `f`
```

```Null as `type` ```  should be as a ```binary(0)``` column in MySQL. but in tidb it is a null type.

issue_context.title: view leads to information_schema.columns data_type null
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1.create view such as ,so the information_schema.columns data_type can get null 
```SQL
 CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`1.1.1.1` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `v_test` (
   `type`) AS
SELECT
 NULL AS `type`,
FROM
 `test` AS `f`
```
2.so we can see the null or other type in information_schema.columns data_type
![](https://tva1.sinaimg.cn/large/e6c9d24egy1h6eh2prflij20hc12kwgb.jpg)

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
the right data_type just like mysql
![](https://tva1.sinaimg.cn/large/e6c9d24egy1h6fl4ltq1wj209w0zq3zh.jpg)

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
the null or wrong data_type
![](https://tva1.sinaimg.cn/large/e6c9d24egy1h6eh2prflij20hc12kwgb.jpg)

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
newest 6.2.0 and 4.0.x

review_comments: So every `null` becomes `binary`? Why not change `type2Str`?

I revert this. I find if null as binary, ```StrToType``` will be output ```"char"```. 

I think it is a problem with the information in infoschema. so that giving the right output can fix this problem.
